title: If an owner subject to the inspection and filing requirements of this section fails to file such report, the owner shall
officialText:
be liable for a civil penalty in an amount not less than two thousand dollars. In such a case, the department may cause a structural inspection to be conducted and a report filed.

ARTICLE 218 SAFETY COMPLIANCE OFFICER
